name: Stella Jean's Ice Cream Pacific Beach
notes: Router flagged the site's Toast payload as a different branch (270 E 17th St). This is a small multi-location ice cream chain (poppieco.com family) whose stellajeans.com/menu page is a single universal price list (chain-wide, not per-branch) that explicitly lists 'PACIFIC BEACH san diego' among its pickup locations, confirming this is the correct chain and branch. Prices are per scoop-size/format (Kids/Single/Double/Split/Pint) rather than per flavor; rotating flavor names (Ube + Pandesal Toffee, Mango Sticky Rice, etc.) are flavor options within these sizes, not separately priced items, so they are not filed as individual dishes. Cross-checked branch address via Grubhub listing 'Pop Pie Co. & Stella Jean's Ice Cream - Pacific Beach - Garnet Ave', 829 Garnet Avenue, San Diego — matches batch address exactly.
